name: steam-addfunds-helper
description: Browser extension that lets you add a custom amount to your Steam wallet.
author: GreedyLabs

scripts.ext:lint: pnpm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.build:zip: pnpm run build && rm -f extension.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../extension.zip . -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test
